ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (as consolidated and amended, notably by Law No. 36 of 2014 and subsequent amendments); the Executive Regulations thereof issued by Prime Minister's Decrees No. 164 of 2018 and No. 95 of 2021, which impose mandatory customer due diligence and beneficial-ownership identification at a 25% ownership or control threshold; the Companies Law No. 149 of 2019 and its Executive Regulations (Prime Minister's Decree No. 2310 of 2020), which require every limited liability company to maintain an internal beneficial-ownership register and to file UBO declarations with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI); and the Central Bank of Egypt's Anti-Money Laundering and Combating Terrorist Financing Regulations applicable to licensed banks and payment-service providers. The Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU) is the designated national Financial Intelligence Unit and the competent AML/CFT supervisory authority with access to the national UBO database.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National Passport Authority / Ministry of Interior of the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Egypt is a party to the Apostille Convention of 5 October 1961, effective 14 December 2013) followed by certified Arabic translation; for non-Apostille source jurisdictions, consular legalization by the Embassy of the Arab Republic of Egypt in the source country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or official Registry Extract of each corporate shareholder (if a parent entity holds shares in the Egyptian LLC)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Companies Registry or Registrar of Companies in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for countries party to the Apostille Convention, followed by Arabic translation; consular legalization of the source-country's registry signature for non-party jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and financial-standing certificate covering the applicant shareholders and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing licensed commercial bank in the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank signature certified by a notary public in the source country and Apostille / consular legalization as applicable, followed by Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney in favor of the licensed Egyptian formation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the country of origin of the principal
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization in the source jurisdiction, followed by certified Arabic translation; original Arabic counterpart executed before an Egyptian notary if the principal appears in Egypt

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of registered residential address of each UBO (utility bill or bank statement not older than three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or issuing licensed bank in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial attestation of the source document followed by Apostille / consular legalization, then Arabic translation by a Ministry of Justice-certified translator

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every shareholder, UBO, director, and authorized signatory against the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons (SDN) list, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, the UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation list, and Egypt's domestic terrorist-entity and terrorist-financing lists established under Law No. 80 of 2002 and the Counter-Terrorism Law No. 94 of 2015. The Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit and the Central Bank of Egypt further require entity-level screening against the CBE blacklist and the EMLCU consolidated non-compliant register. Politically exposed persons must be identified, verified, and subject to enhanced due diligence with documented source-of-funds and source-of-wealth analysis; remittance and corporate-banking counterparties on the SWIFT wire and Stripe payment rails must re-screen the LLC and its principals on a continuous risk-based cycle no less frequent than every 30 days during pre-incorporation and at bank account opening.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI One-Stop-Shop electronic registration portal and the Unified National Commercial Registry (www.gafi.gov.eg; physical filing at GAFI headquarters, Tahrir Complex, Cairo)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory legal name of every Egyptian limited liability company must be expressed in Arabic script. A Latin-character transliteration may be filed only as an auxiliary trading name and has no standalone statutory effect. The name must begin with the approved activity descriptor, avoid duplication or deceptive similarity with any existing registered name, and close with the legal-form indicator 'LLC' (شركة ذات مسئولية محدودة or the accepted abbreviation). Foreign-sounding names are permitted only in Arabic transliteration and must not imply a false provenance, government patronage, or an unlicensed financial activity. The proposed name is subject to the filtering and admissibility review of the GAFI name-clearance engine and the Unified National Commercial Registry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank / بنك (requires prior authorization from the Central Bank of Egypt)
Insurance / تأمين (requires prior authorization from the Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority)
Egypt / مصر and governorate appellations (require presidential or competent ministerial authorization)
Republic / جمهورية, Ministry / وزارة, Government / حكومي (false state affiliation prohibited)
Islamic / إسلامي and explicit religious references (require prior approval of the competent religious-affairs authority)
Financial / مالية, Fintech, Investment Fund, Capital Market (require CBE or FRA regulatory approval)
International / دولية or Global / عالمية in a manner implying institutional status without a genuine multinational nexus
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, GAFI's One-Stop-Shop issues a written reason referencing the specific provision of the Companies Law No. 149 of 2019 Executive Regulations or the Commercial Registry Rules. The applicant may file an administrative objection within 15 working days from the date of notification before the GAFI Dispute Resolution and Name-Clearance Committee, accompanied by (i) a comparative list of names already approved that contain the same or similar tokens and (ii) a legal memorandum in Arabic addressing the statutory ground of rejection. The Committee must decide within 30 days of the filing. A further appeal against an adverse decision lies with the Administrative Court (Egyptian Council of State) within 60 days of the issuance of the committee's reasoned decision, in accordance with Law No. 106 of 2014 promulgating the Administrative Procedures Law.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office or mail-forwarding address does not satisfy Egyptian statutory requirements. GAFI and the Unified National Commercial Registry require a physically identifiable registered office in Egypt evidenced by a lease contract, usufruct, or a licensed serviced-office agreement. A serviced-office arrangement with a licensed business center is accepted as physical presence, provided the LLC's name plaque is posted, records and management files are accessible at the address, and the center maintains reception and mail-handling capacity during statutory working hours. The company must also hold the minimum operational indicia of business substance appropriate to a financial-newswire content aggregator, including data processing infrastructure, a management presence, and bank documentation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Risk quantified at 15-25% probability of an unannounced physical inspection by GAFI or the Commercial Registry within the first 24 months of registration for a low-risk, non-licensed newswire aggregation LLC. The probability increases materially to a mandatory on-site visit upon VAT registration with the Egyptian Tax Authority, upon the opening of a corporate bank account with a CBE-licensed bank, or if the company is selected in a GAFI enterprise-substance inspection sweep. Unannounced inspections are statutorily permitted under the Executive Regulations of Law No. 149 of 2019 and the commercial registry enforcement rules.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended), Articles 53-65 governing Limited Liability Companies; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations No. 2310 of 2018; Commercial Registry provisions under the same laws.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - One-Stop Shop; GAFI processes commercial registry and tax registration concurrently with incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Application Form and notarized Articles of Association / Incorporation Contract, in Arabic, submitted to the GAFI One-Stop Shop.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: For an LLC there is no statutory minimum capital under the Investment Law; capital is set at the founders' discretion in the Articles of Association and is expressed in EGP. Cash quotas must be deposited into an Egyptian licensed bank before incorporation; in-kind quotas must be substantiated by a certified valuation. Escrow and repatriation rules for foreign-currency capital follow the Investment Law's exchange controls.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the incorporators' subscriptions to the quotas of [Company Name] LLC, as set out in the notarized Articles of Association, be and are hereby ratified, allotted and fully accepted. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be fixed at [Registered Address], Cairo, Egypt, and authorized officers may execute all lease, utility, and occupancy documents. RESOLVED that [Founder Name] is appointed Chairperson and [Founder/Officer Name] is appointed General Manager and authorized to open bank accounts, sign contracts, appear before GAFI, and represent the LLC within legal limits. RESOLVED that the GAFI One-Stop Shop application is approved and all incorporation formalities are delegated. Unanimously approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name availability search on GAFI's eInvest portal or at the OSS; file the name clearance application in Arabic; obtain the official name-freeze certificate, reserved for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Name clearance application form
Scanned passport or national ID of each founder
Power of attorney or board resolution (if submitted through an agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected because of conflict or indefinability, the agent may file up to three alternative names within the same working day. A formal negative decision may be reviewed through GAFI's customer service system within 48 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office, Ministry of Justice
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Have a licensed Egyptian attorney draft the Articles of Association; founders sign before the notary; the notary stamps the Arabic original and issues certified copies. If any founder is absent, a notarized power of attorney is required.
required_dossiers: Arabic draft Articles of Association
Statutory declarations of the founders
Passports or national IDs of all founders
Notarized power of attorney for intermediaries (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial corrections are made by re-notarizing a corrected addendum; no full restart of incorporation formalities is required when the correction is submitted within the same registration file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Escrowed Capital Deposit and Bank Capital Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian licensed commercial bank (e.g., NBE, CIB, Bank Misr)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary corporate account in the name of the LLC; deposit the paid-up cash capital; obtain a Capital Deposit Certificate stating the company name, currency, amount, and account number. This certificate is included in the incorporation file.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Name-freeze certificate from GAFI
Passports or IDs of the authorized signatories
Resolution of partners authorizing the bank account
Applicable AML/KYC forms and beneficial ownership statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank asks for additional KYC clarification, submit an updated beneficial ownership declaration and certified passport copies; the bank must re-issue the capital certificate at no fee after commercial clearance within 24 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI One-Stop Shop Incorporation Application and Concurrent Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (Companies Registration, Commercial Registry, Tax Card)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation file to the GAFI OSS. The OSS concurrently issues the incorporation certificate, registers the LLC with the Commercial Registry, obtains the National Tax Card (preliminary), and centralizes all official fees and stamp duties.
required_dossiers: Name-freeze certificate
Notarized Arabic Articles of Association
Capital deposit certificate issued by the bank
Registered office lease contract
Resolution of partners authorizing incorporation and the GAFI application
Completed GAFI incorporation application form
Copies of passports or national IDs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: GAFI issues one consolidated correction notice within the SLA; founders have 15 working days to cure the deficiencies. If incorporation is refused, an appeal lies to the GAFI Grievances Committee under Article 20 of the Investment Law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Official Gazette Publication and Statutory Publicity
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the notice of formation of the LLC, stating its paid-up capital, registered office, and managers, when required or deemed prudent; retain the publication receipt and deliver a certified copy to GAFI and the Commercial Registry.
required_dossiers: Incorporation certificate issued by GAFI
Notarized Articles of Association
GAFI commercial registration record
Board resolution authorizing publication
Arabic publication request form and fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is delayed or returned for correction, the publisher may resubmit a corrected copy; after 30 days from the date of GAFI certification, GAFI may effect publication ex officio.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Operational Civil Defense, Municipal, and Environmental Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipality (Occupancy Licensing), Civil Defense Department, and Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a municipal commercial occupancy permit and pass the on-site Civil Defense inspection; obtain a fire safety certificate; complete the EEAA environmental registration or exemption short form using the non-manufacturing, low-impact service category.
required_dossiers: Lease contract for the registered office
GAFI incorporation certificate and tax card
Civil Defense application and floor plan
Fire-extinguisher and alarm compliance statements
EEAA environmental registration or exemption checklist
Declaration of no harmful industrial processes on site
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any fire-safety non-compliance and request a new inspection within 10 working days; challenge any municipal or civil-defense refusal before the Local Administrative Grievance Committee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: General Authority for Industrial Development (GAID) — not engaged for this ISIC 6391 non-manufacturing newswire activity; local municipal and Civil Defense licensing authorities are competent for the physical office.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Commercial Operating License for Data and Media Services, with Civil Defense Fire Safety Certificate

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) – Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Low-Impact Registration Category — no full Environmental Impact Assessment required; applicant submits an Environmental and Waste Management Checklist to the EEAA electronic portal.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or combustion emissions from pure data aggregation; if standby generators are installed, they must meet Law No. 4/1994 emission limits for PM10, NOx, and CO. Electronic waste below 100 kg/year is handled under general e-waste controls; above that threshold, retain disposal manifests and use licensed recyclers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense fire safety certificate is granted after inspection of smoke detectors, 5 kg ABC extinguishers with valid inspection tags, illuminated exit signage, and electrical load compliance. Municipal structural load inspection and occupancy permit are required. Occupational safety clearance under the Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 covers workplace ventilation, ergonomic seating, fire drill protocol, and emergency medical readiness.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance; corporate and VAT registration portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; e-invoicing portal: https://einvoicing.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An Egyptian LLC incorporated through GAFI is automatically enrolled with the Egyptian Tax Authority for corporate income tax, obtaining a tax card and 14-digit Tax Identification Number (TIN). A foreign non-resident entity not incorporated in Egypt must appoint an Egyptian tax representative, submit constitutional documents, board resolution, power of attorney, evidence of Egypt-source taxable activities, and apply for TIN and VAT registration through the ETA non-resident registration desk. VAT/e-invoicing registration additionally requires obtaining an ETA digital signature certificate and integration with the ETA e-invoicing platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt does not operate a check-the-box regime or hybrid mismatch election. Statutory elections relevant to an Egyptian LLC include: election to file a consolidated income tax return by wholly owned Egyptian corporate group members; election for voluntary VAT registration below the mandatory threshold; selection of acceptable transfer pricing methodology; and election to utilize deductible provisions/bad debt allowances subject to ETA conditions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 in annual taxable supplies is the mandatory VAT registration threshold; EGP 100,000 permits voluntary registration; importers and non-resident suppliers of taxable services/electronic services into Egypt are required to register without regard to turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt mandates real-time e-invoicing for B2B supplies and e-receipts for B2C supplies through the ETA E-Invoice System. Taxpayers must integrate their ERP/billing software using ETA-approved APIs and JSON schema, obtain an X.509 digital certificate, cryptographically sign every invoice, and transmit each invoice for real-time clearance. ETA assigns a unique UUID and QR code; invoices failing ETA clearance are legally invalid and disallow input VAT recovery.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods and services supplied to non-residents for use wholly outside Egypt are eligible for the 0% VAT rate. Eligibility requires the exporter to be VAT registered, to hold valid export documentation, to physically ship goods out of Egypt within statutory timelines, and to receive the foreign-currency export proceeds into an Egyptian bank account within 180 days from the date of export. Input VAT attributable to export sales is creditable and refundable after ETA verification.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Foreign Currency Remittance / Bank Credit Confirmation
Original Export Contract or Sale Order
ETA VAT Export Statement / Zero-Rated Supply Schedule
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA performs risk-based audits by matching customs export declarations, bank FX credits, bills of lading, and e-invoice records. Deficient or fraudulent documentation reverses the 0% rate, triggers VAT at 14% plus late-payment interest from the date of supply, and claws back input VAT credits. Administrative fines range from EGP 5,000 to EGP 50,000 per invoice, and additional penalties up to 100%–200% of the tax evaded may be imposed. Criminal prosecution for fraudulent export zero-rating/refund claims may result in fines up to EGP 100,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years. The statutory audit limitation period is generally 5 years from the end of the relevant tax period, permitting retrospective assessments.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), operating under Law No. 194 of 2020 concerning the Central Bank and the Banking System, together with the CBE Foreign Exchange Committee and licensed dealing banks
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Following the CBE exchange-rate unification effective March 2024, current-account transactions, including cross-border service fees, software licensing, inter-affiliate royalties, and profit remittances supported by a valid tax clearance certificate, are freely convertible through authorized banks at the unified market rate. Capital-account transactions, comprising foreign equity injections, shareholder loans, and portfolio investments, remain subject to documentary substantiation, beneficial-ownership declarations, and CBE balance-of-payments purpose-code verification; external debt registration triggers additional CBE economic substance checks. No general restriction applies to the repatriation of legitimate newswire and data-feed subscription revenue provided the Egyptian LLC maintains current tax filings, obtains annual tax clearance, and routes all payments through licensed banks in accordance with CBE AML/CFT requirements under Law No. 80 of 2002.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the current CBE framework, export and service-export proceeds, including data-feed subscription and syndicated-finance newswire license fees, must be repatriated to Egypt through a licensed bank within the contractually agreed collection period, generally not exceeding six months from invoice date. Proceeds may be credited in foreign currency to the exporter's FCY account or converted into EGP at the unified market rate. The former mandatory conversion ratio was abolished with the March 2024 liberalization, but the statutory repatriation obligation through the banking system remains in force; banks verify the Beneficial Ownership attestation and the underlying commercial contract for every inbound receipt.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (EGP/FCY) and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account (EGP/FCY) and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account (EGP/FCY) and Cross-Border Settlement Account
Cross-Border Operational Account and FCY Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Foreign electronic-money institutions (EMIs) and offshore digital-only cross-border fintechs are not licensed by the CBE to hold EGP accounts, clear domestic payments, or execute FX conversions for Egyptian corporate treasury operations. Offshore EMI onboarding is feasible only for EUR/GBP-denominated collections outside Egypt; all onshore EGP treasury activity, FX conversion, and outbound wire execution must be performed through CBE-licensed banks. The CBE regulatory sandbox currently does not authorize EMI-style multi-currency treasury accounts for closed-loop B2B newswire settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory. CBE AML/CFT rules and bank compliance manuals require an in-person identification interview with at least one authorized signatory and the ultimate beneficial owner before corporate account activation. Remote video onboarding is available only for certain retail accounts of Egyptian nationals; corporate accounts for an Egyptian LLC engaged in syndicated-finance newswire services cannot be opened without presenting the original Commercial Registry extract, valid Tax Card, notarized Articles of Association, Board resolution, power of attorney, and passport copies of the directors at the bank's branch. A relationship-manager due-diligence meeting and approval by the bank's Account Opening Committee are standard requisites.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived mismatch between the registered ISIC 6391 business scope and the actual activity of aggregating and syndicating financial-market news, triggering enhanced due diligence under CBE AML Law No. 80 of 2002
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Client-engagement and content-license agreements with upstream wire-service providers; commercial invoices and data-feed subscriber contracts with financial publishers; platform API terms evidencing legitimate low-risk information-services activity; corporate presentation and website content; transaction-flow diagram showing subscription fees received and licensing fees paid, with the Egyptian company acting as principal licensor.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign shareholder capital injection lacking a clear source-of-funds trail, flagged as potential structuring or layering under CBE circulars
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited bank statements of the remitting shareholder; notarized Board resolution approving the equity injection; shareholder subscription agreement and capital-call notice; valuation documentation where applicable; notarized declaration of source of funds signed by the beneficial owner; Egyptian tax registration certificate; preliminary accounting ledger evidencing the capital receipt.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Failure to produce tax clearance or evidence of current tax filings, which banks require when opening FCY accounts and when processing profit remittances
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid Egyptian Tax Card; latest corporate income tax return with e-filing receipt; annual tax clearance certificate issued by the Egyptian Tax Authority; certified public accountant's letter confirming no outstanding cross-border withholding taxes on foreign licensing flows; confirmation of no outstanding social insurance or stamp-tax liabilities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and PEP screening alerts arising from offshore data-provider counterparties or directors connected to jurisdictions or state media entities covered by restrictive measures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written AML/CTF compliance policy and sanctions-screening logs; independent legal opinion confirming compliance with UN, EU, US, and Egyptian sanctions; contractual representations and warranties from subscribers and data providers confirming no sanctioned counterparties; CBE and EGX/ECHEM declarations for all directors and ultimate shareholders.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections must be routed via SWIFT wire from the foreign shareholder's account to the Egyptian LLC's EGP or FCY settlement account at a CBE-licensed bank. The receiving bank books the credit as a direct-investment inflow and requires completion of the CBE Declaration of Purpose of Transfer using balance-of-payments code 601 (equity participation in an Egyptian company). Verification materials include the notarized Articles of Association showing subscribed capital, the current Commercial Registry extract, the valid Tax Card, and a Board resolution specifying the per-share subscription amount; banks also confirm that the LLC's registered capital is not exceeded without a corresponding capital-amendment filing.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for the ISIC 6391 newswire and API model comprise subscription and licensing fees paid to offshore data providers, cloud-hosting fees, administrative costs, and dividend or shareholder-loan remittances. All are settled via SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers from the LLC's EGP or FCY accounts after FX conversion at the unified market rate. Open-account settlement against a commercial invoice is the standard clearing rail; a documentary remittance with invoice verification is applied where the payee requires guaranteed payment. A standby Commercial Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700) is used only for substantive physical procurement, and every outbound transfer must cite the applicable CBE purpose code and be supported by the underlying contract and, where relevant, a tax-withholding certificate.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable EGP/USD and EGP/EUR forward contracts executed with CBE-licensed banks, with tenors customarily up to 24 months for trade and investment hedging under an ISDA or Egyptian Master Agreement
FX cross-currency swaps between EGP and USD or EUR, requiring documented underlying exposure and CBE dealing-room confirmation
Plain-vanilla interest-rate swaps and cross-currency interest-rate swaps embedded in syndicated-finance facilities, executed with a bank licensed and regulated in Egypt
Onshore EGP/USD FX options or collar structures, where offered by licensed dealing banks, subject to CBE valuation, margin, and delivery rules

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing EGP are not permissible for onshore corporate treasury operations; only onshore deliverable forward contracts satisfying CBE mark-to-market and margin requirements are recognized

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Return (Form CU-1) accompanied by financial statements and transfer-pricing disclosure
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the fiscal year-end; fixed calendar deadline of April 30 for a December 31 year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Escalating pecuniary penalties: 5% of assessed tax for the first overdue month, increasing by 5% per month up to a 20% cap, plus monthly late-payment interest; persistent default enables summary tax assessment, asset attachment, tax-card suspension, and referral to enforced collection, with administrative strike-off as the final sanction

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited annual financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, cash-flow statement, and auditor's report) deposited with the Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months from the fiscal year-end; June 30 for a December 31 year-end, concurrent with the shareholders' general assembly approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine against the LLC and its managers; registration of the company is blocked in the Commercial Registry, preventing renewals and notarized contracts; non-deposit extending beyond 12 months triggers admi-nistrative strike-off and liquidation proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry verification and renewal filing (confirmation of capital, managers, activities, and address)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Department, Internal Trade Development Authority (ITDA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: During the anniversary month of original commercial registration; for calendar-year filers, commonly between January and March each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late penalty accrues on the renewal fee; after 3 months of delay the Commercial Registry suspends the company's registration; after 12 months without renewal the entry is administratively delisted, causing inoperability of bank accounts and inability to execute legally binding contracts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) e-registry confirmation, including notification of any shareholding transfers executed during the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI electronic UBO platform, in coordination with the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any shareholding transfer; annual re-confirmation submitted simultaneously with the audited financial statements filing (June 30 for a December 31 year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: AML administrative penalties of up to EGP 100,000 plus suspension of share-transfer registration; repeated breach may restrict the commercial license, impede dividend distributions, and ultimately lead to administrative strike-off of the entity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Notarized minutes of the annual shareholders' general assembly approving the audited financial statements and discharging the managers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the fiscal year-end; June 30 for a December 31 year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine imposed on the company; defective minutes are rejected and the financial statements are treated as undisclosed; continued failure may trigger compulsory liquidation and disqualification of the managers from serving on other Egyptian licensed entities

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Egypt's Companies Law (Law No. 4 of 2022), every LLC must appoint at least one independent certified auditor; the auditor's report is mandatory for the annual financial statements approved by the shareholders' assembly, with no capital or revenue exemption. ETA size thresholds (capital above approximately EGP 1,000,000 or revenue above approximately EGP 5,000,000) require a fully audited file for tax settlement, whereas smaller taxpayers may submit simplified reviewed statements; however, the statutory auditor appointment remains compulsory regardless of size
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) as issued by the Financial Regulatory Authority, converged with IFRS; full IFRS is applied by listed entities and licensed financial intermediaries, while the mandatory national GAAP for statutory accounts is EAS

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Egypt's AML/CFT legal framework, the company must maintain an internal UBO register and report each shareholding transfer to the GAFI e-registry within 30 days of execution; annually, concurrent with the audited financial statements filing, the company must re-confirm recorded UBOs and certify that no undisclosed transfers occurred during the fiscal year. Share transfers are not recognized until the updated UBO declaration is accepted
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders' General Assemblies
Statutory Auditor Appointment and Discharge Records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – 900 annually for a registered agent and physical office service in Cairo; virtual office solutions range from USD 250 – 600 annually
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – 3,500 for a standard low-risk LLC audited file; premium of up to USD 6,000 may apply for financial-sector-related scope or consolidated group accounts

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% (Law No. 91 of 2005, as amended; standard corporate rate for commercial and industrial companies)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Tax holidays under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 for eligible Suez Canal Economic Zone projects; up to 50% deduction for qualifying research/development activities; export-oriented entities may benefit under special free-zone regimes; SME preferential rates as prescribed by ministerial regulations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 25 (Corporate Income Tax Return) submitted electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) online portal (https://eta.gov.eg)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months following the end of the fiscal year; upon prior ETA approval, extension may be granted by up to three additional months.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer legal name, trade registration number, and Egyptian Tax Identification Number (TIN)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entity must hold an Egyptian TIN obtained through registration with the ETA and provide its local address and tax representative details.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year commencement and close dates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the accounting period used for the non-resident's Egypt-source income computation; must align with the Egyptian accounting period for permanent establishments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenues from Egyptian sources and worldwide income attributable to an Egyptian permanent establishment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report revenues derived from syndicated financial newswire subscriptions, data licensing, and commission income sourced to Egypt; exclude foreign income unless treaty-dependent business profits are attributable to a PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenses, cost of services, and bad debt write-offs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only expenses actually incurred to generate Egyptian-source income and supported by documentation are deductible; intra-group recharge invoices must comply with transfer pricing provisions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after aggregating specified tax base adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply tax treaty provisions and Egyptian controlled-foreign-company rules only if the non-resident entity is conclusively tax-resident in a treaty jurisdiction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income multiplied by the applicable statutory rate (22.5%)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-residents taxed on gross basis (e.g., royalties, technical fees), compute at the applicable withholding rate as elected in the filing annexures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for Egyptian final withholding taxes and estimated income tax payments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim DTA-reduced withholding credits by attaching the certificate of residence (TRC) of the foreign beneficial owner and the beneficial ownership declaration.

Bank payment must be executed via an accredited Egyptian bank using the ETA deposit reference; non-resident must ensure payment from a non-resident account is denominated in EGP or convertible currency as accepted.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a monthly fine of EGP 1,000 to EGP 5,000 per return; failure to pay assessed tax triggers an additional tax of 2% per month of the overdue amount; deliberate non-submission may lead to criminal prosecution with fines up to EGP 500,000 and imprisonment for up to five years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends distributed by Egyptian companies to non-resident shareholders (Law No. 91 of 2005, Article 56); reduced to 5% or exempt under DTA where conditions and minimum shareholding thresholds are met.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident must file a written application with the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) on the prescribed form before the payment date, attaching: (i) the latest Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign competent authority; (ii) a certificate of beneficial ownership signed by the ultimate recipient; (iii) legalized corporate documents of the recipient; and (iv) a declaration of the underlying transaction. If relief is applied after an excessive withholding, a refund application must be filed within five years from the payment date with the same evidence package. The ETA generally issues an advance ruling on reduced WHT within 30 days; expedited review is available for listed dividend declarations.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory royalty rate is 20% on payments for patents, trademarks, copyright, and technological/software licenses; statutory interest rate is 20% on loans, deposits, and overdrafts; treaty rates are commonly 10% for interest and 15-20% for royalties depending on the jurisdiction, subject to beneficial ownership confirmation and DTA limitations-on-benefits clauses.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File where the taxpayer's gross revenue exceeds EGP 20 million and aggregate related-party transactions exceed EGP 5 million; Master File required when the multinational group's consolidated revenue exceeds EGP 500 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not maintain a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations code, but the Egyptian Income Tax Law No. 91/2005 applies a general substance-over-form principle and a business-purpose doctrine. A non-resident entity (including fintech newswire companies receiving Egypt-source subscription income) must demonstrate substantive decision-making, contracts, and operational activity in Egypt or in its treaty residence to avoid re-characterization of commercial income as a permanent establishment and to secure treaty benefits. Where revenue is routed through an intermediary shell company in a zero-tax jurisdiction, the ETA may pierce the structure and attribute profits to a deemed Egyptian establishment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Fictitious invoicing routed through shell entities; underreporting Egypt-source subscription and syndicated finance news feed revenues; false expense deductions or balance sheet concealment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Unpaid tax recovered immediately with a penalty equal to 100% to 200% of the evaded amount; criminal fine from EGP 5,000 to EGP 500,000 and imprisonment for up to five years; publication of the judgment in the commercial registry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and managers who sign false returns or knowingly participate in stamping of false invoices are personally assessed for unpaid tax and civil restitution; travel bans are issued for tax arrears exceeding EGP 1 million; criminal sentences may include imprisonment and disqualification from board service.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a letterbox entity in Egypt solely to hold contracts for a syndicated newswire API while actual business operations remain in Dubai or a no-tax jurisdiction, without staff, office presence, or genuine commercial function in Egypt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Refusal to operate as a non-resident entity; recharacterization as a permanent establishment; imposition of unpaid corporate income tax on gross turnover (or deemed margin), plus a 100% penalty; denial of treaty benefits; deregistration from the ETA commercial registry.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be jointly and severally liable for taxes that cannot be recovered from the sham entity; administrative travel bans may be issued; in egregious placement of third-party funds, charges of money laundering under Egyptian AML Law No. 80 of 2002 may result in imprisonment from 3 to 15 years and asset confiscation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation and Reporting Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to submit TP disclosure forms, Local File, Master File, or CbC notification despite crossing statutory thresholds; failure to prepare contemporaneous arm's-length documentation within 120 days of the filing deadline; abusive intercompany financing or royalty recharges on the financial newswire data platform.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fixed fine of EGP 1,000 per day of delay up to a maximum of EGP 100,000; adjustment of the taxable income upward by 30% or more for the undocumented transaction; potential secondary adjustment for under-payment of dividends and deemed distribution taxes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Chief financial officers and managing directors are personally liable for the penalty if they deliberately omit documentation; criminal liability arises if the omission masks tax evasion; courts may impose imprisonment for habitual default and issue personal asset freezes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Onboarding sanctioned clients or routing subscription payments from embargoed territories through the newswire API; failing to perform beneficial-owner screening; retention of incomplete customer due diligence records for syndicated finance data sales.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to EGP 1 million per AML violation under Egyptian Money Laundering Law; additional administrative fines and freezing orders from the Egyptian Economic Security Authority; where funds are linked to terrorism, imprisonment for up to 15 years and criminal confiscation of proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Responsible compliance officers and board directors are personally prosecutable for inadequate sanctions screening; court-mandated travel bans and passport seizure apply to havaperatus of accused directors; civil restitution to the injured party may be enforced against personal assets.
